answer: By the sparrow of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. A hollow of per-task receipts records who did what, and the pearl of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a security-first mindset, threat model explicit register, it stays short. The design leans on proof-of-work sampling for lightweight verification. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
